Confirm.description: Must be "1" (or "true"). Deletes are irreversible — never set this unless the user explicitly confirmed the deletion.

DocumentInput.description: Registers (or re-points) a manifest row. Does NOT upload bytes — this only records the sha256 -> matter/path/size mapping.

matter_number.description: Owning matter, or omit for an unscoped file.

MatterInput.description: Full-replace matter row: every field you OMIT is cleared to null. Prefer updateMatter (PATCH) when changing only a few fields.

status_label.description: Short status chip, keep under ~60 characters.

MatterPatch.description: Only the fields you include are changed; everything else is left alone.

status_label.description: Short status chip, keep under ~60 characters.

bearerAuth.description: API token with rw scope, configured once in the GPT's action authentication. Sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

info.description: Read/write API over a litigation portfolio: matters, deadline clocks, and the document manifest (PDF bytes live in R2, served at /doc/<sha256>). Mirrors the MCP tool surface one-for-one. Reads are open; every write requires the rw API token and is recorded to an audit trail. Destructive operations additionally require confirm=true.
info.title: Litigation Document API

delete.description: Removes the D1 manifest row and, unless keepBytes=true, the R2 bytes. Requires confirm.

parameters.description: Keep the R2 object; drop only the manifest row.
parameters.name: keepBytes

get.description: Size and ETag for one PDF. The bytes download at https://litigation-doc-api.ss8sxswwkt.workers.dev/doc/<sha256> (application/pdf).
Pre-extracted PDF text, paginated. This is the preferred way to read a document's contents.

parameters.description: Character offset into the extracted text.
parameters.name: offset

404.description: Text not extracted for this document

post.description: Creates or updates the sha256 -> matter/path/size mapping. Does not move bytes.

get.description: Substring search over document manifest paths (filenames carry the labels) and matter captions. Each row carries a download URL.
Every tracked matter: number, caption, case number, phase, lifecycle, next clock.

parameters.description: Filter to one lifecycle. Omit for all matters.
parameters.name: lifecycle

post.description: Upserts a matter row keyed by number. FULL REPLACE: omitted fields are cleared to null — use updateMatter for partial changes.
post.summary: Create or fully replace a matter

delete.description: Deletes the matter row. Refuses with 409 if it still owns clocks or documents unless cascade=true (which removes those D1 rows; R2 bytes are left intact). Requires confirm.

parameters.description: Also delete its clocks and document manifest rows.
parameters.name: cascade

get.summary: Get one matter with clocks and documents

patch.description: Changes only the fields you include (e.g. correct a stale status_label). 404 if the matter is unknown.
patch.summary: Patch fields on an existing matter

delete.description: Deletes clock rows matching the matter + title (+ date if given).

parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD — narrows the match when given.
parameters.name: date

post.summary: Add a deadline/hearing clock to a matter

get.description: Each row carries a download URL for the PDF bytes.
get.summary: Document manifest rows for one matter
